messages.subject: Sentvia pharmacovigilance platform - need your help
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've selected Sentvia's Vigil platform to replace our ageing Argus safety database. Their lawyers (Ashworth Quinn) have sent over a draft SaaS agreement and it's fairly supplier-friendly. Can your team take the lead on reviewing and negotiating it? The data-protection and regulatory provisions are the ones that worry me most given we're MHRA-regulated.

Naomi (our GC) will be your day-to-day contact on our side.

Thanks,
Helena

Hi Helena,

Delighted to help. I've looped in James Osei who will lead day to day, with Elena Marchetti supporting. Our engagement letter is attached - if you could countersign and return that would be great.

We'll prioritise the liability cap, the data processing agreement and the regulatory/audit co-operation provisions. Send us the Sentvia draft and we'll mark it up.

Sarah Whitfield
